_about: Rule constants and wording for the battle ruleset (Yuddh engine, Battle Master content). Edit values here; the engine reads them.

morale._about: A unit routs when a blow leaves it at or below 1/lineDivisor of its maximum health (rounded up) and it was above that line before. Routed units flee to the Support Line and take no action in their owner's next turn.

ai._about: The search AI (level 'search'): each turn it beam-searches its own action sequences on a copy of the board, with unseen cards re-dealt at random, then plays the opponent's reply and scores where that leaves it. Bigger numbers play better and think longer.

sharad.name: Clear
sharad.rule: Clear skies, firm ground. No special rule.

varsha.name: Rain
varsha.rule: Mud: no unit can advance and attack in the same turn, not even cavalry.

grishma.name: Heat
grishma.rule: Heat haze: ranged units deal 1 less damage (never less than 1).

hemanta.name: Harvest
hemanta.rule: The harvest fair: both sides have 1 extra Supply every turn.
